patterns.name: Split Stat
patterns.whenToUse: Filled title carries exactly one real impressive number.

exampleProps.title: Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, DoorDash, Coinbase, Reddit

patterns.name: Big Number
patterns.whenToUse: Title is essentially just a number with no descriptor.

patterns.name: Icon Stat
patterns.whenToUse: A real stat plus a curated icon and a short headline.

patterns.name: Icon Headline
patterns.purpose: Centered icon + headline. The honest floor (fills white space when no data).
patterns.whenToUse: No real stat or entity list available — the honest fallback.

exampleProps.title: Be in the room with top investors

patterns.name: Logo Wall
patterns.purpose: Centered header over a large branded logo/entity grid.
patterns.whenToUse: 4+ real named entities and the scene is a dedicated customer/portfolio wall.

patterns.name: Feature List
patterns.purpose: A vertical list of check/dot rows.
patterns.whenToUse: 3+ short feature/benefit lines (entities or bullet subtitle).

patterns.name: Device Frame
patterns.purpose: Text-left / a real product screenshot in a clean browser frame, right.
patterns.whenToUse: A product beat that carries a real captured screenshot.

patterns.name: Comparison Columns
patterns.purpose: A two-column contrast: the muted old way vs the accented Filmo way.
patterns.whenToUse: The planner extracted a real before/after contrast with 2+ items per side.

patterns.name: Pull Quote
patterns.purpose: A large editorial testimonial: a centered quote with an accent quote-mark and an attribution line.
patterns.whenToUse: The source carries a real, attributed quote of at least ~6 words. Never invented -- absent or unattributed quote falls through to the honest floor.

exampleProps.title: What customers say
exampleProps.quote: We launched our product video in an afternoon instead of a month.

patterns.name: Kinetic Statement
patterns.purpose: A big editorial hook that assembles word-by-word (rise-blur), one keyword tinted in accent with a glow halo, an optional highlighter sweep under one word.
patterns.whenToUse: An opt-in hook beat (kind=hook) with real verbatim copy and no competing stat/entity/quote data. The manifesto / hook beat.

patterns.name: Process Pipeline
patterns.purpose: A horizontal row of numbered step cards joined by animated connector arrows that draw left-to-right — a 'how it works in N steps' flow.
patterns.whenToUse: The source carries 2-4 real, ordered process steps (an ops / onboarding / how-it-works beat). Never invented — fewer than 2 real steps falls through to the honest floor.

steps.title: Upload
steps.body: Drop POs in any format — PDFs, emails, scans, EDI.

steps.title: Extract
steps.body: AI reads vendor, line items, quantities, and prices.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Approve in seconds — flag anomalies before they ship.

steps.title: Sync
steps.body: Push to your ERP. Print travelers. Done.

patterns.name: Scan Grid
patterns.purpose: An accent AI scanline sweeps a grid of entity tiles (lighting each row as it passes) with a live N/Total counter — the active 'we analyze everything' sibling of the logo grid.
patterns.whenToUse: A scale/coverage beat: a real corpus count (stat) plus 6+ real named entities/categories. Below the grid threshold it falls through to the honest floor.
